option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a broader category of neurodegenerative disorders, but the specific clinical presentation and genetic findings point to a more specific diagnosis than FTD alone.
Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis–Frontotemporal Dementia (ALS-FTD) is directly equivalent to the provided leaf 'ALS-FTD'.
Frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease (FTLD-MND) is an alternative term for ALS-FTD, representing the same clinical entity.

Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related) is a more specific description of ALS-FTD, incorporating the genetic finding, but still refers to the same core disease entity as 'ALS-FTD'.
